label: July 13–19, 2026
intro: Magic week! Real magicians from around the world land in Bangkok — plus a giant riverside sports festival on Sunday.

activities.title: Thailand Magic Arts Festival 2026
activities.why: Two days of live magic — gala shows, a one-hour Magic Theatre production, and interactive magic experiences with performers from Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Thailand. Watching real magic up close at 5 is pure wonder.
activities.tip: The Magic Theatre Full Show is the most kid-sized chunk — one hour of pure spectacle. Book ahead.

activities.title: Marathon & Sports Festival at Rama VIII Bridge
activities.why: 30,000+ runners, festival stalls, and riverside entertainment. Go cheer, soak up the energy, and let Thor run his own 'race' in the park after.
activities.tip: Go early before the heat — it's a morning event.

activities.title: Neo Land Festival
activities.why: The big walk-through contemporary art festival is still on — immersive installations a 5-year-old can wander through wide-eyed.

activities.title: Book a Chocolate-Making Session
activities.why: He loved making chocolate — theCOMMONS runs kids' sessions with a real chef periodically. A weekday afternoon slot beats the weekend crowds.
activities.tip: Check the events page early in the week and book.

activities.title: Book a Pottery Session at Clay Circle
activities.why: Pottery was a hit — Clay Circle welcomes kids for hands-on clay sessions. Squish, shape, glaze, and pick up your masterpiece later.
